name: The web service audit: one line per write, refusal or file transfer
summary: Service.audit appends one redacted event (time, request id, user, actor, credential, project, action, outcome, reason of at most 200 characters); never a secret or a body. _mutate writes the committed/rejected/denied/unknown line of every write; _note_denied the line of a 401/403; the task files routes one line per upload, download and withdrawal with task and sha256 in the reason. A project admin reads it with GET /v1/projects/{id}/audit.
